items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Leo Williams' relationship with Dizzy Gillespie ('He played first alto with Diz, when Diz had his first band'), but does not describe a personal relationship between himself and Dizzy Gillespie.

ctx.x: Then he left. He had to go home. His mother and them made him come home. Then I was lucky enough to get Leo Williams. He just had come back from Trummy's. He was with Trummy, too. He went with Trummy when Trummy had that band. Yeah, he could blow. He could play... See, he and Bird... Bird came around here, and he and Bird hung out together all the time. Then he quit playing tenor and started playing alto. He played first alto with Diz, when Diz had his first band. Then he came around here and hooked up on that…
